chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Baseer, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them)...

...regarding a man who gave a man dirhams to perform Hajj on his behalf, an exclusive Hajj. Would it be permissible for him to perform Tamattu' with Umrah to Hajj? He said: Yes, he merely differed from him in performing the more meritorious one.

key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعَ: To perform Tamattu' (combining Umrah and Hajj)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a proxy performing Hajj on behalf of someone else to perform Tamattu' instead of Ifrad?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a proxy performing Hajj on behalf of another may validly choose Hajj al-Tamattu' over the stipulated Hajj al-Ifrad, as the shift represents an increase in merit (fadl) rather than a deviation from the core obligation. Shia jurists cite this to support the principle that unless the donor explicitly restricts the form of worship, the agent's choice of a more virtuous method is permissible and beneficial to the principal. This ruling underscores the flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding delegated acts of worship, prioritizing the spiritual benefit of the act over rigid procedural adherence when no specific constraint is imposed.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, fom Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>)

regarding a man who gives Dirhams to a man to perform Hajj on his behalf, an exclusive Hajj. Would it suffice for him if he were to perform Tamatto with the Umra to the Hajj?’ So heasws said: ‘Yes. But rather, he would have opposed him to perform the more meritorious one’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Hisham ibn Salim from abu Basir who has said the following: “I once asked one of the two Imam, (abu Ja’far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam,

about a man who pays someone to perform al-Hajj in Ifrad manner (al-Hajj without al- £ Umrah) for him; if it is permissible to perform in al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous) manner. He (the Imam) said, ‘He has opposed him in what is more virtuous.’”
